How much of your life is being shaped by decisions you don’t realise you’re making?

@sethgodin has spent decades trying to understand that question.

Seth is one of the most influential thinkers in modern marketing, leadership and creativity. He’s a bestselling author who has written more than 20 books, and when I started my career in marketing, his ideas were everywhere.

So sitting down with him felt like a full-circle moment.

I wanted to find out why we stay in careers, businesses and relationships we know aren’t working, how to know when quitting is the right decision, and what happens as AI changes the world of work.

We discussed things like:

- How to know when it’s time to quit.
- Why fear, status and belonging shape your choices.
- Why AI could change the world more than we expect.
- The human skills that could matter more in an AI world.
- How to take back control when you feel stuck.

One of Seth’s main talking points is that there are forces shaping our decisions that most of us rarely stop to notice. Fear, status, the years or money we’ve already invested, and the systems around us can all make us feel like we have fewer choices than we actually do.

What I like about Seth is that he doesn’t tell you what decision to make. He helps you see what is influencing that decision so you can make it for yourself.

With AI changing so quickly, I think the ability to adapt, question the path you’re on and know when to change direction is going to matter more than ever.

Seth said something that I think sits at the heart of this entire conversation: “We still get to decide.”

When so much around us is changing, remembering that we still have a say in what happens next really matters.

Out now on all platforms. Let me know what you think of this one in the comments ❤️👊🏾
